title:
Helper type to consolidate useful APIs for authoring of {@link MlPipe} and {@link MlPipeline}.
Example usage:
```py
>>> from sklearn import linear_model
>>> lr = c3.MlPipe.convert(linear_model.LinearRegression())
>>> mla = c3.MlPipeline.Authoring
>>> x = mla.var()
>>> y = mla.var()
>>> y_pred = lr(x, y)
>>> pipeline = mla.pipeline(x={'iris_features': x},
                            y={'iris_class': y},
                            out={'iris_class_pred': y_pred})
```
name: MlPipeline.Authoring
